title: ServiceNow Discovery — configuration, order of operations, CI Class Manager, duplicate avoidance & CMDB insert/update
escalation_note: First pass used local small models (qwen2.5-coder:7b, llama3.2:3b, deepseek-r1:32b, gemma2:9b). They produced unfocused summaries, so the swarm escalated to stronger FREE API models. See 06_FINALSUMMARY.md.

worktrees.goal: Fetch vendor docs and author the authoritative sections on (1) Discovery configuration options and (2) order of operations; assemble the combined report.
worktrees.files_scope: Only files under this worktree's files/.

worktrees.goal: Write the 'CI Class Manager' section. Cover: how to open it (All > Configuration > CI Class Manager), the class hierarchy tree, and each class-nav tab (Class Info, Attributes, Identification and Reconciliation, Dependent Relationships, Suggested Relationships, All Relationship Rules, Health, CI List) — what each controls. Include the class-creation wizard steps and where to set an attribute as a CI identifier.

Write the 'Duplicate avoidance' section. Explain how Discovery/IRE prevents duplicate CIs: identification rules and identifier entries (regular/lookup/hybrid), the skip_duplicates property and threshold, duplicate_of tagging, de-duplication tasks, lookup/related duplicate handling, and the exact property names and defaults.

Write the 'Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE)' section. Explain identification (source_name/source_native_key, identifier keys, identifier entries), reconciliation (static vs dynamic rules, data refresh rules), and precisely how IRE decides insert vs update. Name the tables (cmdb_reconciliation_definition, cmdb_dynamic_reconciliation_definition, cmdb_datasource_last_update).

Write the 'CMDB insert/update behaviour' section. Explain what happens on insert vs update, that reconciliation is not applied on insert, how authoritative sources gate attribute writes, CI reclassification flags (updateWithoutUpgrade/Downgrade/Switch), payload hygiene (<=500 CIs, no dupes), and how to prevent accidental overwrites.
